lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello, Mama. I am in Dubai. Everything is good. Everything is... very good.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: My job is great. The company is big. The money is... yes, it is good. Do not worry.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, what? Sorry, can you repeat that, please? I did not understand.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Dune and Company. We need your answer by Friday. Are you still with us?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes. Yes, I am here. Sorry, one moment. I am listening.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُمْ يَا جَمَاعَة فِي يَلَّا فْلُوَنْت! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاكُمْ كُلْ يَوْم، عَشَان نِتْعَلَّم إِنْجِلِيزِي وِإِحْنَا مُبْسُوطِين... النَّهَارْدَة، مَعَانَا مَكَال، مِصْرِي فِي دُبَاي، بِيِحْكِي لِأُمُّه كَلَام كِبِير، وِقَلْبُه مِشْ مِرْتَاح خَالِص.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبَعْدِين... التِّلِيفُون بِيِرِن، وَالشُّغْل بِيِسْأَلُه سُؤَال صَعْب. يَا تُرَى هَيِقُول إِيه؟ خَلِّيكُمْ مَعَانَا، وِاسْمَعُوا كْوَيِّس.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: رَكِّزُوا النَّهَارْدَة عَلَى تَلَاتَة عِبَارَات... لَمَّا تِقَابِل حَد، قُول: Hello, I am... وَتَانِي وَاحِدَة: Nice to meet you. وَلَو مِفْهِمْتِش، قُول بِهُدُوء: Sorry, can you repeat that, please?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا بَيْنَا... نِسْمَع مَكَال، وِنِتْعَلَّم مِنُّه!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: No, Mama, I am not tired. Dubai is very nice. The weather is hot, but I am okay.
lines.direction: warm but forcing it, voice note energy

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: My manager? He is very happy with me. Yes. Everything is fine. I live here since two years now, Mama, and—

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, Mama, one moment. Sorry, one moment. There is another call. I will call you later. Bye.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello? This is Macal speaking.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Hello, Macal. This is Mrs. Fernandes from Dune and Company. Am I speaking with the right person?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes, yes. I am Macal. Nice to meet you... I mean, nice to speak with you.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. So, Macal, we have your Rising Voices application here. We need your answer by Friday. Are you still with us?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, can you repeat that, please? I did not understand the last part.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Of course. I said, are you still interested in the fellowship? Friday is the deadline.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes. Yes, I am interested. Very interested. I am working on my project now. Macal Empire. It is... it is coming.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Good. Send us a short voice note about your idea. Two minutes, no more. Can you do that by Friday?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes, of course. Two minutes. Friday. I understand. Thank you, Mrs. Fernandes.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal? You look like you just saw a ghost. What happened?
lines.direction: light, teasing, catching him off guard

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nour. Hi. Hello. I am fine. I just... I have a voice note to make. A big one.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: A voice note? For your mom again?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: No. For Dune and Company. The fellowship. They want my idea in two minutes. My real idea.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay, then. Let us hear it. Say it to me first. Right now.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Now? Here? Nour, I do not know. My English is... okay, but this is important.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal. Your English is good. Just talk. Start with hello. Hello, my name is Macal, and I have an idea.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello. My name is Macal. I am from Egypt. I live in Dubai... and I have an idea. I want to help people learn English. Like me.
lines.direction: slow, finding his footing, then warming

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلّا يَا جَمَاعَة، وِقْفَة سَرِيعَة مَعَ مَحْمُود!... أَوَّل جُمْلَة: Nice to speak with you. يَعْنِي تَشَرَّفْت بِالكَلَام مَعَاك، بِنِقُولْهَا فِي التِّلِيفُون أَكْتَر مِن الوِيش تو وِيش. مَثَلًا: Hello, nice to speak with you, Mrs. Fernandes. تَانِي جُمْلَة: Can you repeat that, please?... دِي أَهَم جُمْلَة لَمَّا مِتْفَهْمِش، وبِتَدِيك فُرْصَة تِسْمَع تَانِي مِن غِير حَرَج. وَتَلَاتَة: Are you still interested? يَعْنِي لِسَّه مُهْتَم؟

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَس خُد بِالك: مَاكَال قَالَ Nice to meet you فِي التِّلِيفُون. الغَلْطَة دِي طَبِيعِيَّة... لِأَنَّ فِي العَرَبِي كِلْمَة وَاحْدَة 'تَشَرَّفْنَا' لِلْحَاجَتَيْن. فِي الإِنْجِلِيزِي، فِي المُقَابَلَة الوِيش تو وِيش بِتَقُول Nice to meet you، لَكِن فِي التِّلِيفُون بِتَقُول Nice to speak with you.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي، لَاب الوَاكْسِنْت!... النَّهَارْدَة عَن Word stress، يَعْنِي إِنْتَه مَبْتِقُولْش الكَلْمَة كِلْهَا بِنَفْس القُوَّة. اسْمَع: application. غَلَط: appliCAtion. صَح: appliCAtion. رَدِّدْ: application. وَكَمَان: interested. غَلَط: interesTED. صَح: INterested. رَدِّدْ: interested. الشِّدَّة بِتَفَرَّق أَكْتَر مِن أَي صَوْت. يَلّا، رَدِّدْ مَعَايَا!

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That was good, Macal. Really good. Now send it. Do not think too much.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait. I am not sure about the ending. It is... it is too simple. And the beginning... I said nice to meet you. On a voice note. That is wrong, yes?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You are right. It is nice to speak with you. But Macal, listen. One small word is not your whole idea. Your idea is strong.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Okay. I understand. I will fix it. ... Nour, thank you. Really.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Do not thank me yet. Thank me when they say yes. Go. Record it.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello. My name is Macal. Nice to speak with you, Mrs. Fernandes. I am from Egypt. I live in Dubai, and I have an idea. I want to help people learn English. Like me. This is Macal Empire.

lines.speaker: Official
lines.text: Mr. Macal? This is Dune and Company. Thank you for your voice note. It was good. But we need one more thing.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, can you repeat that, please? I did not understand the last part.

lines.speaker: Official
lines.text: Yes, of course. We need your two-minute video by Friday. Not a voice note. A video. Do you understand?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes. Yes, I understand. A video. Friday. I can do that. Thank you. Nice to speak with you. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: Friend_M
lines.text: Bro, that was Tarek. He says the team is watching. Do not embarrass us.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلّا يَا جَمَاعَة، نِلَخَّص بِسُرْعَة... فِي التِّلِيفُون بِتَقُول Nice to speak with you، وَمِش Nice to meet you. وَلَمَّا مِتْفَهْمِش، بِتُقُول بِهُدُوء: Can you repeat that, please?
lines.direction: warm, quick recap, clear emphasis on the two English phrases

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدِلْوَقْتِي... عِبَارَة الحَلْقَة! اسْمَع كْوَيِّس: Can you repeat that, please? دِي الْعِبَارَة اللي هَتْفَتْح لَك كُل الأَبْوَاب، لِأَنَّهَا بِتَقُول لِلنَّاس: أَنَا مُحْتَرِم، وَأَنَا بِتَعَلَّم، وَكَمَّل مَعَايَا!
lines.direction: proud, building energy, then soft and encouraging

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: فَخُد الوَاجِب دَه... سَجِّل ڤُويس نُوت قَصِير، عَشَر ثَوَانِي بَس، وَقُول فِيهَا: Hello, nice to speak with you. Can you repeat that, please? بِصَوْت وَاضِح، وَبِالثِّقَة، زَي مَا اتَّفَقْنَا.
lines.direction: inviting, playful challenge, slow on the English phrase

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَابْعَتَهَا عَلَى تِلِيجْرَام... فِي Empire English Community. إِحْنَا هِنِسْمَع صَوْتَك، وَنِشَجَّعَك، وَنِقُول لَك إِيه اللي حِلْو وَإِيه اللي يِتْحَسَّن. إِنْتَ مِش لَوْحْدَك فِي الحِكَايَة دِي!
lines.direction: belonging, warm group feeling, slight smile in the voice

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلّا... المَايك مَعَاك. رُوح سَجِّل، وَأَنَا مُسْتَني سَمَاع صَوْتَك. وَلَاقِينَا فِي الحَلْقَة الجَايَة، وَمَاكَال... لِسَّه عِنْدُه مُشْكِلَة كَبِيرَة!
lines.direction: energetic send-off, teasing hook for next episode

phrase_of_episode.ar: مُمْكِن تْعِيد دَه تَانِي، لَوْ سَمَحْت؟

phonetic_focus.note: Which syllable carries the beat (e.g. reCORD the verb vs. REcord the noun). Getting stress right matters more than any single sound.
